sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Gary Ewing stole three golf clubs in Los Angeles. He received a 25-year prison sentence under California law. He argues this punishment is excessive. California argues the sentence fits its statutory scheme.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the limits of state sentencing power. It determines whether states can impose long terms for minor crimes. It shapes how courts review proportionality claims nationwide.
